summary: No change; validation confirms no_change. I checked one last candidate — whether a follower can forward a ReadIndex back and forth between two nodes that each believe the other is leader — and the monotone-term argument rules it out: a node that believes leaderID=X is a follower, X claiming leadership requires a heartbeat at a higher term, and a node that later wins an election sets its own leaderID to itself, so two nodes cannot simultaneously hold stale mutual leadership beliefs that would loop the request. That trace changes no recorded account, and with the seven questions answered, no open gaps and every citation aligned to the revision in use, the record stands as it is. No execution was run.
